| `major_sdo_id` | `uint(4)` | `0` |   | majorSdoId (transportSpecific in IEEE 1588-2008): 0 for the default profiles, 1 for IEEE 802.1AS (gPTP). |
| `message_type` | `enum(4)` | `0` (sync) |   | Message type: 0 Sync, 1 Delay\_Req, 2 Pdelay\_Req, 3 Pdelay\_Resp, 8 Follow\_Up, 9 Delay\_Resp, 10 Pdelay\_Resp\_Follow\_Up, 11 Announce, 12 Signaling, 13 Management. |

| `flags` | `flags(16)` | `0x0` |   | Flag field: alternateMaster, twoStep, unicast, the profile specific and security bits in the first octet; leap61, leap59, currentUtcOffsetValid, ptpTimescale, timeTraceable, frequencyTraceable and synchronizationUncertain in the second. |
| `correction_field` | `int(64)` | `0` |   | Correction in nanoseconds multiplied by 2^16 (signed). |

| `port_number` | `uint(16)` | `1` |   | Port number of the source port. |
| `sequence_id` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   | Sequence ID; a Follow\_Up / Delay\_Resp / Pdelay\_Resp copies the one of the message it answers. |
| `control_field` | `enum(8)` | `0` (sync) |   | Control field (IEEE 1588 version 1 compatibility): 0 Sync, 1 Delay\_Req, 2 Follow\_Up, 3 Delay\_Resp, 4 Management, 5 other messages. |
